about_the_game:
REM – a poignant point-and-click adventure exploring acceptance of loss, artificial comfort, and the memory of love. Journalist Alex, after losing his beloved Luna in a tragic accident, encounters an AI-generated reflection of her in his dreams. Yet every puzzle, choice, and dialogue blurs the line between reality and illusion.

As a player, you’ll step into Alex’s past, uncover the dark corners of his memory, and shape the narrative through your decisions. Different choices lead to multiple endings, and each playthrough reveals new details.

Key Features

  • Story-Driven Gameplay: Deep character relationships, multi-layered dialogue, and thematic progression.

  • Point & Click Mechanics: Explore environments, find clues, interact with objects, and solve mysteries.

  • Narrative-Integrated Puzzles: Each puzzle unveils a part of Alex’s past and his relationship with Luna.

  • Choice-Shaped Story: Your decisions affect tone, relationships, and which ending you reach.

  • Pastel & Neon Color Palette: A visual contrast that reflects transitions between real world, dreams, and the AI realm.

  • Original Music & Sound Design: Unique compositions and ambient sounds that enhance the emotion.

  • 4–6 Hour Emotional Journey: Replayable with multiple endings awaiting your choices.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2300 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Headphones are recommended for the best experience.

short_description: Dreams can bring back what you’ve lost… or bind you to it forever. REM is a point-and-click adventure with cinematic visuals, an emotional story, puzzles, and multiple endings shaped by your choices.
supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Turkish
*languages with full audio support
